title: Did Everyone With Any Brains Emigrate from Scotland? “More than ten per cent of Scotland's 16 to 19-year-olds have taken cocaine.” But The Police Are Looking For Cannabis Farms.

content_html_sanitized:
Analysis by Richard Cowan 

Sometime over 200 years ago, a fellow named Cowan got on a leaky ship in Scotland and took the great risk of sailing to America. There is some indication that he was in a hurry because of a problem with the law. Whatever his motive, I will always be grateful to him to the point of ancestor worship. God bless you, sir! 

Nonetheless, Scotland really is an extraordinary little country. It only has about five million people, but it has made a vastly disproportionate contribution to the world, but today it is suffering from some very serious self-inflicted wounds. 

Although all of the UK has a serious case of reefer madness and some of the worst substance abuse problems in Europe, Scotland seems to have the worst of the worst. In 2002, I really thought that things were about to turn around. 

See 

Founder of Edinburgh’s First Coffee Shop Issues Challenge to the UK Government: “Give us twelve months to show that there is a solution...” A Brilliantly Practical Suggestion. and 

Two More Stories from The UK That We Couldn’t Make Up: 10,000 Scots Addicted To Dangerous Over-The-Counter Drugs and Bristol Police Drunk and Lewd At “Anti-Drug” Benefit. 

But now I am not so optimistic about the near term. The worse the situation gets the more obsessed with prohibitionism they become. Like the English, they have elevated prohibitionist quacks to the status of gurus. They seem to think that Professor Neil McKeganey, director of the centre for drugs misuse research at Glasgow University could walk across the lochs. He is bad enough to have our Drug Czar as a fan. Of course, alcohol is the worst “Scotch” problem, as it is everywhere. 

See 

Program Notes for the MarijuanaNews World Report May 2, 2005 Drug Czar Imports Scottish “Expert” Who Says Cannabis As Big A Threat As Heroin. Scotland A Mess. Interview With Steve Kubby About His Case 

Last year I reported on the deteriorating situation in Europe. 

See 

International “Prohibition Situation Report” – DEAland Media Ignore News Showing Cannabis Prohibition Is Counterproductive. Coffee Shop System Survives. 

But Scotland ranks among the worst. With a population of only 5 million it has an estimated 60,000 “problem drug users.” That is more than twice the number that the Dutch have with a population of over 16 million. 

There were 421 drug-related deaths in 2006 - 25% more than in 2005 and 73% up on 1996; Holland had 127. 

To make matters even more bizarre, last December, the Observer reported, “Residential drug rehabilitation places at one of Scotland's leading addiction hospitals are being taken by Dutch heroin users because authorities in Scotland will not pay to use them, preferring to put addicts on methadone instead.” 

In 2005, I reported that the price of heroin was falling in Scotland, but the police are still focused on cannabis. 

See 

Program Notes for The MarijuanaNews World Report for May 30, 2005 Australians Outraged By Corby Case, Should Look In Mirror. UK Judges Say Sick, Dying Criminals, Hard Drug Use Soars. Home Grow Booms. 

Now the price of cocaine is falling. On Monday, The Edinburgh Evening News that “more than ten per cent of Scotland's 16 to 19-year-olds have taken cocaine.” But the police are out looking for “cannabis farms.” 

Last November the Glasgow Daily Herald reported that in the last year, 33,000 plants had been seized from 70 “farms, which were being run by “triads” – a Chinese-Vietnamese crime group…. and it is supposedly being exported. 

From 2002, see 

The DEA Is Telling UK Narks That "Britain's drug barons are exporting home grown, high grade cannabis to Holland in exchange for Dutch ecstasy." 

Now here is the punchline: “The Scots-grown cannabis contains almost seven times more of the dangerous chemical THC than foreign imports….” 

So that brings me back to the rhetorical question in my headline: Did Everyone With Any Brains Emigrate from Scotland?
